title: Manual AAPS delivered bolus not picked up in treatments, may not be in IOB
symptom: A manual bolus administered via AAPS and showing in pump history is not showing in treatments or uploaded to Nightscout. It is unclear if it is included in IOB, and IOB may be undercounted. At the time, AAPS issued a basal not updated followed by a bolus not delivered alert.
evidence_quote: 21.05 - manual bolus administered via AAPS and showing in pump history not showing in treatments or uploaded to Nightscout. Not clear that it's included in IOB. IOB may be undercounted.
